route.name: Right: preloads, corner pick, HIVE volley, wall FLOWER, park

Right: preloads, corner pick, HIVE volle.note: RoboDux, from video (Kentwood Q, 20 Nov 2026 review), red frame, times after PLAY. Seen in Q-29, Q-34, M-3, M-10; Q-23 and M-7 ran the same order late and did not park (FTCScout P0 in both, P5 in the four). Start at the audience end beside our RIGHT_START, in 8/8 matches (high). Preloads at the AUDIENCE CELL: first ball ~0.9 s (0.4-1.5), last ball ~2.1 s (1.4-2.2), its own preloads tip it, CELL read up ~4.5 s (medium-high); leaves ~3.0 s. Then the pieces on the audience wall by the red-wall corner (stop read as a pick, intake not visible), under its own red HIVE ~11-17 s with a second volley seen only in Q-34 at ~12-13 s (red's 2 AUTO TIPs in M-3/M-10 support it; low-medium), the red-wall FLOWER ~19-22 s, park in the LOADING ZONE ~24-27 s. Positions +-6-10 in (camera zooms mid-match); under-HIVE spot low confidence. Not a final hiding spot: it uses the space under the HIVE as a launch spot. Heading is CAN'T TELL from the stream camera; the h values are placeholders.

route.name: Right corner: two volleys, wall FLOWER, park

Right corner: two volleys, wall FLOWER,.note: Wayland, from video (Kentwood Q, 20 Nov 2026 review), red frame, times after PLAY. The same Auto in all nine: Q-4, Q-15, Q-20, Q-25, Q-33, M-2, M-4, M-7, M-9 (Q-33 blocked by its partner at the FLOWER and parked late, ~24.5 s). Starts in the corner of the red and audience walls (moderate, +-6-8 in), at its launch spot near the audience wall by ~1 s (high on timing). First volley at the AUDIENCE CELL ~3-6.5 s (M-4, its TIP swung 8-10 s) / ~5-8 s (Q-4) (moderate). Red-wall FLOWER by ~10.5 s, sits 1.5-2 s (read as a pick; count not visible), back at the launch spot ~14.5 s, second volley ending ~17.5-19 s (Q-4 17.5-20.0; low-moderate), parks on effectively our RIGHT_PARK by ~21.5 s (19.5-24.5). FTCScout: AUTO PARK 9/9; alliance AUTO TIP 4/9. Heading is CAN'T TELL from the stream camera; the h values are placeholders.

Right: preloads + park.note: OverClucked, from video (Coloma Q, 20 Nov 2026 review), red frame, times after PLAY. The same Auto in all eight: Q-3, Q-9, Q-19, Q-26, Q-39, M-4, M-7, M-10 (high). Path traced frame by frame at 15 fps in all eight (camera mapped by the field corners, +-3 in): starts against the audience wall at (31.4, 8.7) (spread under 2 in), ~24 in toward the red wall from our RIGHT_START. Three preloads at the AUDIENCE CELL: first ball median 3.2 s (1.5-4.0), last ball 3.8 s (2.2-4.8); its CELL tipped in 4/8 (Q-19, Q-26, Q-39, M-10), TIP lag (last ball to CELL settled) ~4.3 s. Leaves at 6.0 s (4.7-7.2), drives dead straight up x=32 to y~62 in ~1.1 s, then cuts diagonally to the red wall, touching it at ~(9, 99) and settling at (15, 98) (end spread +-4 in), parked 2.3 s after leaving (8.2 s median, 6.9-9.4), then still to 30 s. No FLOWER picks. FTCScout: LEAVE and AUTO PARK 8/8. Heading CAN'T TELL (square open-box robot; it does not visibly turn): h 90 is a placeholder.
